visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short dark hair, wearing a black and white checkered puff-sleeve top, stands in front of a wooden door. She looks directly at the camera, speaking with animated facial expressions and hand gestures, pointing her finger for emphasis. (2) Graphic overlays appear showing colorful trash can products and then anime-style girl illustrations associated with the colors. (3) The scene cuts back to the woman speaking in the same indoor setting, leaning forward slightly as she narrates. (4) A screen recording of a messaging app interface is shown with chat bubbles and emojis. (5) The camera shows a pink cardboard box being opened by a person whose face is covered by a white heart graphic. The person is sitting on the floor in a room with a bed and luggage visible in the background. (6) The camera angle becomes shaky and tilted, showing a door and ceiling momentarily as the person laughs and moves the camera around. (7) Back to the woman in the checkered top, she is now leaning against the large pink cardboard box, covering her mouth while laughing. (8) The person with the heart-obscured face sits next to the pink box, gesturing toward it while speaking. (9) A final black screen with white text and two laughing emojis appears.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female voice speaking rapidly in Mandarin, accompanied by a bouncy, upbeat synthesized comedy BGM track. (2) A 'pop' or 'bubble' sound effect triggers as product graphics appear on screen; music continues with consistent tempo. (3) Transition to an even higher arousal vocal state as the speaker begins laughing; BGM maintains its rhythmic drive. (4) Distinctive high-pitched 'swan-like' laughter sound effect (meme SFX) cuts in periodically over the primary speech. (5) Interaction audio between two females; one is laughing while the other speaks with a slightly indignant but humorous tone. (6) Rustling sounds of cardboard being handled are audible beneath the high-volume laughter and BGM. (7) Final phase with a quick decrease in vocal volume followed by a hard cut to silence as the video ends.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Context -> Conflict (The Error) -> Climax (The Reveal) -> Resolution
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to entertain the audience by sharing a humorous personal anecdote about a failed online shopping experience. The creator describes how she intended to buy a stylish trash can but accidentally purchased one made of cardboard because she failed to read the store's name, 'Cardboard Furniture'. The contrast between the cute advertisement and the physical cardboard box provides the comedic value.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Mention of brands like Rakuten and Daiso are incidental to the story rather than promotional.
